name: Rift Herald
texts: When I move to a battlefield, look at the top 3 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a unit from among them and draw it. Recycle the rest. [Deathknell][>] Play a unit from your hand to your base, ignoring its Energy cost.
manual: When I move to a battlefield, look at the top 3 cards of your Main Deck.
You may reveal a unit from among them and draw it.
[Deathknell][>] Play a unit from your hand to your base, ignoring its Energy cost.
